thread:
mike: CI turned red on buildkite at 1245 — image push failing after we switched to rootless + squash in the Dockerfile. Registry returns '422 Unprocessable Entity - invalid layer metadata'. Anyone seen this with squash/rootless?

mike: log snippet:```error: upload manifest failed: 422 Unprocessable Entity - invalid layer metadata: tar header uid/gid mismatch for path /app/bin```

tina: is this using buildkit/kaniko or docker cli? which builder flags changed in the PR?

mike: buildkit via buildx + buildkitd. PR only added `--squash` and switched to rootless runner (podman-rootless style).

rahul: likely the squash step is re-tarring layers with different uid/gid (rootless maps to 65534). Some registries validate owner metadata in tar headers. quick check: `tar -tvf layer.tar | head` to see uid/gid.

mike: ran the tar check, here's sample:```-rw-r--r-- root/root      2048 2026-03-17 12:01 app/start.sh
-rwxr-xr-x 65534/65534   1024 2026-03-17 12:01 app/bin/run``` so mix of 0 and 65534.

olga: ugh. registry rejects the layer because manifest has file uids that don't match image metadata. Possible quick workaround: chown files to a single uid before squash, or disable squash.

rahul: actionable options:
- disable `--squash` in CI for now (fast).
- in Dockerfile add `RUN chown -R 1000:1000 /app` before final image so tar headers are consistent.
- configure buildkit to use UID/GID remap / tar_owner flag if available.

ci-bot: buildkite: rerun queued for build 1245 (triggered by mike) :rocket:

registry-bot: registry: manifest validation failed for repo redwood/test-image: tag=canary, reason=layer header uid/gid inconsistency, code=422

tina: I can run a local reproducer with the same buildkit config. if disabling squash fixes it we should roll that back and open an issue to fix rootless+squash combo.

rahul: also double-check any gzip/tar tool versions in the builder image — older tar/bsdtar variants change numeric ids when re-tarring.

mike: previous build 1244 (pre-squash) succeeded. so it's almost certainly squash-related.

tina: quick test: `buildctl build --frontend=dockerfile.v0 --local context=. --local dockerfile=. --export-cache type=inline --no-squash` -> after building, push to registry, pushed OK locally.

tina: confirmed: disabling squash reproducer pushes fine. squashed image fails with same 422.

mike: ok let's revert squash in the CI patch and add a follow-up bug to add a deterministic chown step or fix buildkit config. @rahul can you own the bisect / follow-up?

rahul: I got it. I'll bisect the PRs that flipped rootless and squash and open an issue with steps to reproduce + suggested fixes.

olga: leaving a note for the ops runbook: if you see 422 + 'uid/gid' text, try disable-squash or chown hack as temporary. I'll add it. :memo:

mike: thanks all — rerun landed green after disabling squash. I'll revert the squash commit in the PR and mention the follow-up. :white_check_mark:
